name: Topological Persistence and Simplification
aliases: Topological Persistence and Simplification — Contour Spectrum
definition: The contour spectrum is a method of relaying quantitative information about individual contours in scalar data, including surface area and volume.
summary: Topological Persistence and Simplification extracts quantitative contour metrics to identify salient structures and remove noise, distinguishing itself from raw histograms by incorporating geometric and topological data.
